statements.t: For Q4 2026, we expect revenue of $254-$256 million, representing 32-33% growth year-over-year driven by approximately 35-36% marketplace growth.
For Q4 2026, we expect Adjusted EBITDA of $22-$22.5 million, an improvement from Adjusted EBITDA of $8.4 million in Q4 2025.
For Full Year 2026, we are raising our revenue growth outlook from previous guidance of 33-34% to at least 37% driven by approximately 41% marketplace growth.
For Full Year 2026, we expect Adjusted EBITDA of $68-$68.5 million, an improvement from an Adjusted EBITDA of $18.5 million in Full Year 2025.

The Company’s marketplace makes it possible for buyers to quickly receive pricing, expected lead times, and manufacturability feedback and place orders on the marketplace.
In order to continue to meet the needs of buyers and remain highly competitive, we expect to continue to add suppliers to our platform that have new and innovative manufacturing processes.
The acquisition of GoBRANDgo is expected to enhance our marketing services offering through GoBRANDgo’s AI and automation capabilities.

In addition, the GoBRANDgo Asset Purchase Agreement includes a contingent consideration arrangement to the former owners of GoBRANDgo to receive up to 28,454 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock based on the achievement of 2026 and 2027 performance targets.

In addition to the measures presented in our condensed consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, we use the following key operational and business metrics to help us evaluate our marketplace business, measure our performance, identify trends affecting our business, formulate business plans and develop forecasts, and make strategic decisions:
Once an account joins our platform, we aim to expand the relationship and increase engagement and spending activities from that account over time.
We expect the cost of revenue to increase in absolute dollars to the extent our revenue increases and transaction volume increases.
As we grow and add suppliers to our platform, we are able to improve our pricing efficiency and we expect cost of revenue to decline as a percentage of revenue over time.
We intend to continue to invest in our sales and marketing capabilities in the future to continue to increase our brand awareness, add new accounts and further penetrate existing accounts.
We expect sales and marketing expense to increase in absolute dollars in the future as we grow our business but decrease over time as a percentage of revenue.
We expect operations and support expenses to increase in absolute dollars in the future as we grow our business but decrease over time as a percentage of revenue.
We expect product development expense to increase in absolute dollars in the future as we grow our business but decrease over time as a percentage of revenue.
We expect general and administrative expenses to increase in absolute dollars in the future as we grow our business but decrease over time as a percentage of revenue.
We believe our existing cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities will be sufficient to support our working capital and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next twelve months.

We believe we will meet our longer-term expected future cash requirements primarily from a combination of cash flow from operating activities and available cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities.

We intend to use the net proceeds from the 2026 Common Stock Issuance working capital and general corporate purposes, including, but not limited to, general and administrative matters, repayment of debt, capital expenditures and acquisitions of other businesses or assets.
